svg.title: OutCrop forge mark: an anvil with a hot billet, sparks and a resting hammer
svg.desc: Original artwork made for OutCrop, not taken from any game. A squared anvil (base, step, waist and a thick bevelled top slab), a glowing billet, square sparks and a hammer leaning with its foot on the base, built as flat-shaded bevelled boxes seen from the front and a little above, with painted cracks, scratches, chips and wood grain. Every mark is paint over a solid face, so nothing of the page shows through inside the drawing. The viewBox is cropped to the drawing plus a small margin, landscape like the hero slot it fills.
